subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **Choice.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word in the fill-the-blanks is **choice.**
 
• **Choice** means **an act of choosing between two or more possibilities. **
 
 
• **​Example- **The** choice **between red and black.
 
 
 
• Thus the appropriate word is choice.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word** difference** means **a point or way in which people or things are dissimilar.**
 
• The word** Gap **means **a break or space in an object or between two objects.**
 
• The word **Bridge **means** a structure carrying a road, path, railway, etc. across a river, road, or other obstacles**.
